package.name: x30_navigation
package.description: Where the X30 walks to (the ROS Noetic port of dharma_navigation): a planner on the site map with a footprint costmap and replanning, routes loaded from the active site, a path follower with pluggable controllers (holonomic, pure pursuit, Stanley, LQR, MPPI, PID), path shifting around obstacles, reactive avoidance policies and stop point inspections, and tag-based docking; every command goes to the control mux (control/nav_cmd_vel), never to the robot.
